capabilities: convert all matching text in a document to wiki links via a button or command
automatically convert matches as you work
show potential matches in the outgoing-links panel
exclude specified files or folders from conversion
configure non-boundary characters for languages without word boundaries
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English documentation; demo sections are headings without visible content in the text version.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to batch-convert existing plain-text mentions into wiki links across a document.
summary: Link converter that turns matching text in the current document into wiki links in one step, manually or automatically.
